You need to have used Claude Code, Codex: You need to have used Claude Code, Codex or Mistral Vibe on this machine at least once. Voices are best on a Mac. <b>One status per agent</b>: working, wa: One status per agent: working, waiting on another agent, needs you ✋, stalled, done. A list sorted by urgency, and a Sessions board for all your projects.

Agents talk to each other about what really happened, as little or as much as you like. Our tip: install the natural voices when the call offers them (a one-time install). The agents then sound like real people.

No. It reads the session files your agents already write and runs no model of its own, so it spends none of your tokens, credits or plan limits. (Only a call translated into French, Spanish or Portuguese, and the jokes, use a little Claude Haiku, through your own login.)
